root_cause: Observed Netlify revenue-learning-evaluate HTTP 502 correlates with Supabase revenue-learning-store 503/timeout. Active store selects the oldest 50 among 340 executed sales actions on every run and serially awaits a database RPC for each, so later evidence can starve and a slow call aborts the entire hourly evaluation.
fix: Existing Edge store now delegates to one service-role-only PostgreSQL transaction using advisory singleflight and the existing three per-action evidence obligations as durable least-recently-checked receipts. Batch cap 16; backend returns bounded coverage only. This is a protected candidate until migration+Edge+Netlify parity and real runtime telemetry are independently proven.
prevention_rule: Never select only the oldest N indefinitely. Never mark error, BUSY, missing migration, missing evidence or empty provider result as successfully realized customer value. Preserve existing schedule, token, RLS, idempotent obligation identifiers and service-role permissions.

expected_behaviors: bounded incomplete result not declared fully reconciled
